scripts/check.sh check entry point
nodes.rationale: CI has no logic of its own, so a failed CI job X is reproduced with scripts/check.sh X

nodes.label: scripts/linux-build.sh Linux build script (CDPATH guard, HEAD and clean tree checks)
nodes.rationale: Copy of the spec 0001 command, byte for byte after the marker line, guarded by W7; spec 0001 stays the single owner of platform and image

nodes.label: Dependency policy (deny.toml)
nodes.rationale: One tool and one file for advisories, licenses, bans and sources; the license list is exactly what the lockfiles need

nodes.label: unsound = "all" in deny.toml advisories
nodes.rationale: Written out because the cargo-deny 0.20.2 default looks at direct dependencies only; a safe first party Rust project most wants to hear about unsound dependencies anywhere in the graph

nodes.label: Workspace Clippy lint rules (dbg_macro, print_stderr, print_stdout, todo, unimplemented)
pool-repo-check repository check program
nodes.rationale: No dependencies, outside the workspace so scope 001 criteria on members and lockfile stay true

nodes.label: Workspace guards W1-W7
W1 lockfile package set guard (three lockfiles vs baseline files)
W2 forbidden paths guard
W3 forbidden source patterns guard (plain text tripwire)
W4 lint inheritance guard (comments cut, * member is a problem)
W5 internal dependencies guard (four spellings, package = renames)
W6 unexpected Cargo.lock guard
W7 Linux build command copy guard
CI definition guards C1-C5
C1 actions pinned by commit hash
C2 job ids equal required status check contexts
C3 fixed shape after jobs: (allowed keys, exact run values, one-line run steps, last run is the job's own check)
nodes.rationale: Keeps CI free of logic of its own; reports continue-on-error, if:, shell:, env: and other keys that change whether a step runs

nodes.label: C3 allowed key list (runs-on, timeout-minutes, steps, uses, with, persist-credentials, fetch-depth, path, key, run)
C4 exactly one runs-on per job, value ubuntu-24.04-arm
C5 ci.yml is the only workflow file, one top-level permissions: contents: read, no pull_request_target or secrets
Document checks D1-D6
D1 local link path exists
D2 link fragment is a heading anchor
D3 scope index and feature files agree
D4 no ID defined twice
D5 every cited ID is defined
D6 IDs of base revision still defined
Fuzz harness (pool-config-fuzz, validate target, CDPATH cleared in child shell)
Software inventory (CycloneDX SBOM)
CI definition (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
Branch rule and change path (main ruleset)
nodes.rationale: Pull request only main follows from the standards and spec 0001; nobody on the bypass list

nodes.label: required_review_thread_resolution: open review threads block a merge
nodes.rationale: Observed 2026-11-14: automatic Copilot review left two threads, merge stayed BLOCKED until both resolved; outdated is not resolved; resolving needs owner permission

nodes.label: Automatic Copilot code review on the owner's account
Limit of merge commit only: direct push of a green open PR head with 0 approvals
How a change reaches main (six steps: branch, scope/<number>-<slug> push and PR, checks, settle review threads, merge, closing PR)
Closing pull request from scope/<number>-closing
nodes.rationale: Evidence that exists only after the scope pull request ran reaches main through a second pull request; replaces the push of main (coordination skill step 9)

nodes.label: Pull request template
Proving the checks (scripts/prove-checks.sh, 28 cases)
Proof case 22: deny rejects a Git source dependency (source-not-allowed)
Proof case 23: deny rejects a wildcard requirement serde_json = "*" (error[wildcard])
Proof case 24: guards C3 rejects continue-on-error
Proof case 25: guards C4 rejects ubuntu-latest
Proof case 26: guards C5 rejects contents: write
Proof case 27: guards W6 rejects docs/Cargo.lock
Proof case 28: docs D4 rejects a duplicate SEC-14 row
Remote proof (remote steps 1-8, run by the lead)
nodes.rationale: Order is part of the design: the workflow first runs while main has no rule, the rule is applied only after seven green checks

nodes.label: Remote step 1: push the scope branch and open the pull request (AC-3)
Remote step 2: read the Linux build lines (AC-5)
Remote step 3: apply the branch rule (AC-13)
Remote step 4: a direct push is refused (AC-13)
Remote step 5: a wrong change is blocked (AC-12)
Remote step 6: merge (AC-3)
Remote step 7: the closing pull request (AC-3, AC-19)
Remote step 8: the first daily run
Note: a first pull request that does not start the ci workflow (close and reopen)
nodes.rationale: On 2026-11-14 gh pr create ran one second after the push bringing ci.yml; only Copilot review started. Cause is a guess. Close and reopen keeps the checked head commit, unlike an extra commit

nodes.label: Direct push probe: an empty commit made with git commit-tree on top of origin/main
nodes.rationale: Belongs to no pull request and has no check run, so an active rule has two reasons to refuse it; not the PR head, which GitHub may accept

nodes.rationale: Found by the review of 2026-11-14 and left on purpose: guards catch honest drift and help the reviewer, they do not stop a person who means to get around them
